title: Boston University Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Boston University Taiwanese Student Association (BUTSA, 波士頓大學台灣同學會) is a student organization dedicated to promoting Taiwanese culture and history at Boston University. Its stated purpose is to unite students with an interest in Taiwanese backgrounds through a variety of events. BUTSA is open to all students regardless of background, welcoming anyone with an interest in Taiwan. The org’s WordPress site (butsaa.wordpress.com) lists a contact email of butsaa@bu.edu and links to its Facebook Group.

Documented past programming includes job-search workshops, barbecues, and cultural festival celebrations. An earlier version of the organization’s website (butsa.weebly.com, also using the Chinese name 波士頓大學台灣同學會) and a separate archived site (baronet-j.com/butsa) document activity going back to at least the 2011–2013 academic years. BUTSA also maintains an Instagram at @butsa.tw. BU’s Spring 2022 SAO Org Directory lists a ‘Taiwanese Student Association (Graduate)’ as a separate graduate-tier organization (org ID 23300), indicating that BUTSA may serve primarily graduate or international students from Taiwan, distinct from the undergraduate-focused BUTASA.

Sources: butsaa.wordpress.com (org website, last confirmed active post June 2018); butsa.weebly.com (org website); www.bu.edu/studentactivities/files/2022/02/SAO-Org-Directory-sp22.pdf (BU SAO Org Directory, Spring 2022); instagram.com/butsa.tw.
